integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic checks support algebraic formulas; the analytic regenerative/spectral and polynomial arguments prove the infinite-time statement and global sign ranges. Publication priority and independent scientific verification remain unestablished.
scientific_limitations: Ideal unit-efficiency rank-one measurement jumps; a single monitored channel; fixed g,gamma>0 and Delta real; long-time ordinary cumulant rates only. The Delta=0 finite-time count transform was previously established, so the resonant specialization is not separately novel. General full-counting tools are prior work; implicit equivalences in broader literature remain possible.
title: Detuning-blind third click cumulant and a sharp fourth-order sign boundary in monitored qubits
